source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: ICSE Class VIII school half-yearly mathematics paper II (school not named), scanned with no text layer. Header prints 'HALF YEARLY EXAM 2023-2024', 'Class- VIII', 'Subject- MATHS IInd', 'Time- 3hr', 'M.M.-50', 'Note:-Every questions is compulsory.' examYear 2024 is the later year of the printed session (file name also ends 300524-2024). Marks come from the printed section brackets: Q1 [1 ×5], Q2 [1 ×7], Q3 [1 ×8], Q4 [1×10] (the ten factorisation items of part 1) and [2 × 4] (the four definitions of part 2), Q5 [3 ×4] 'Attempt any four' of five items (all five share choiceGroup 5). Powers and one fraction were rebuilt from the page images. Student ticks and crossings on the scan were ignored. No answer key is printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
